title: Louisiana Nextlink hold: the 104-location cohort still lacks adoption and retention fields
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: The current official record keeps the tower live and 104 locations serviceable but does not publish the stable location list, installations, subscribers, tests, retained users, price, affordability, complaints, or accepted closeout. Denominator: The same 104 BEAD locations, followed through eligible, serviceable, installed, subscribed, tested, retained, priced, complained, and accepted-closeout states.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Adoption and activation hold.

Finding: The current official record keeps the tower live and 104 locations serviceable but does not publish the stable location list, installations, subscribers, tests, retained users, price, affordability, complaints, or accepted closeout.
Denominator: The same 104 BEAD locations, followed through eligible, serviceable, installed, subscribed, tested, retained, priced, complained, and accepted-closeout states.
Boundary: Serviceable locations are not installed or subscribed locations.
Boundary: No take-rate denominator, retention window, affordability measure, or complaint series is disclosed.
Boundary: A live tower is not accepted cohort closeout or demonstrated adoption.
Next action: Reopen with the stable 104-location roster and periodized installations, subscribers, tests, latency, uptime, price, affordability, retention, complaints, and accepted closeout.
why_it_matters: The visible hold prevents repeated inventories, plans, serviceability, capacity, or component data from being presented as reliability, adoption, accepted output, recurring rate, or a complete program baseline.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves entity, cohort, lifecycle stage, period, unit, threshold operator, denominator, revision history, and attribution.
Separates inventory, reliability, adoption, feed, glass, containers, quality, shipment, acceptance, disposal, capacity, baseline, outcome, closeout, implementation, and closure.
Keeps dated checks and exact-artifact retrieval non-blocking.
evidence_limits: Not publicly acquired does not mean nonexistent, withheld, or never submitted.
FTFN public-source research is not agency contact or a submitted FOIA request.
Serviceable locations are not installed or subscribed locations.
No take-rate denominator, retention window, affordability measure, or complaint series is disclosed.
A live tower is not accepted cohort closeout or demonstrated adoption.
GAO acceptance, implementation, closure, and entity evidence remain separate from this content expansion.
No record supports a ranking, composite score, readiness score, generalized savings claim, or unsupported causal inference.
